title: Risk Policies
coreMove: replace isolated risk decisions with a standing policy that sees the whole portfolio
sourcePressure: argues that broad risk policies beat one-off choices because narrow framing invites inconsistency
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: framing this as courage to take risks rather than broad framing and consistency

hook: opening with a named bias definition for Risk Policies
starting in a lecture hall or generic seminar
counterintuition: the obvious advice is simply slow down
smart people are immune if they know the term
tryThisNow: write three lessons in a journal
examples: student in a classroom guessing an answer
